S01: In the old port city of Basra, where the golden minarets are mirrored in the river, lived Prince Zayn.
S02: But Zayn did not think of his kingdom's troubles.
S03: His world was full only of feasts and revels.
S04: Day and night, music and laughter rang through the palace.
S05: No one dared tell him that his care had vanished.
S06: One evening, when the sun had set, Zayn fell asleep on his silk bed.
S07: In his dream a silver mist arose.
S08: An old man whispered him counsel — to rule more wisely.
S09: But Zayn refused the counsel and turned to the other side.
S10: But the old man returned — and showed him an entrance to a chamber full of gold coins.
S11: The gold gleamed like living flame.
S12: As soon as he woke, Zayn ordered the guards to dig at the hidden place.
S13: The diggers came to a heavy stone door underground.
S14: There, full of radiance, stood the chamber of the nine golden pillars.
S15: On eight pillars stood marble statues, but the ninth was empty.
S16: Upon it shone only a single inscription.
S17: The ninth statue, the most precious, waited in distant Egypt.
S18: Zayn prepared a caravan and set out into the unknown.
S19: On the way, a guide offered to lead him to the City of Spirits.
S20: Before them blazed the City of Spirits — beautiful as a dream.
S21: The gardens were lush, and the buildings rose to the sky.
S22: Guide: "If we do not flee before the Royal Palace, the king of spirits may appear to us as a monster."
S23: Then before them the Royal Palace opened.
S24: From the light appeared the King of Spirits himself.
S25: King of Spirits: "Welcome, Zayn. I am the old man from your dreams."
S26: Zayn recognized in him the good old man from the dream.
S27: The king offered him a bargain: he would give him the statue for the most beautiful girl in the world.
S28: To help him, the king gave him a flying carpet and a magic mirror.
S29: The mirror lit up and showed a stranger's face.
S30: In it was reflected the princess of Persia.
S31: Flying on the magic carpet, Zayn crossed deserts and mountains.
S32: The wind fluttered his cloak and his resolve.
S33: The carpet descended into the gardens of the Persian palace.
S34: Among the flowers, Zayn caught sight of her.
S35: She was more beautiful than anything he had ever seen.
S36: Zayn took her onto the carpet to carry her to Egypt.
S37: But on the heavenly road, his heart changed.
S38: Zayn brought the princess before the king of spirits.
S39: His heart was broken — she had slipped from his hand.
S40: King of Spirits: "Go home. The ninth statue is already with the other eight."
S41: Zayn returned to Basra, and the road seemed longer than ever.
S42: At once he descended to the underground chamber by the nine pillars.
S43: In the place of the ninth statue stood someone far more familiar.
S44: There awaited him his beloved princess.
S45: Spirit: "She truly is the most precious statue!"
S46: Zayn married the girl, and from then on ruled wisely, beloved by all.
